cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for dinner with me. I've learned your mother's dumplings, and they're ready to steam. We serve them now, not between other appointments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's at the networking dinner. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then decline before we start the steamer. Eight minutes, lid closed; I won't have you taking calls halfway through the meal I've made for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We froze our anniversary dinner on that promise. Fill the steamer to this line, please, and tell the director you're already having dinner with me.

reason: Replace generic table-arrangement insistence with precise meal sequence and steamer instructions that require choosing this dinner before work interrupts it.
